result.title: Asymptotic Behavior of Transformers
result.summary: In this paper we study the behavior of transformer networks generating text over long periods of time. We show that even a three-token, single-layer attention-only transformer can fail to converge. We then study a rich class of transformers with arbitrary finite depth, layer normalization, MLPs, RoPE encodings, and an arbitrary mix of local and global layers. Every transformer in this class has a softmax temperature threshold above which its empirical cache distribution converges to a unique limit, independent of initial conditions. We show further that, while each transformer has a temperature threshold, the supremum of this set is infinite, so there is no global minimal temperature that forces all transformers to converge.

AI.brief_summary: 论文从理论上研究 transformer 长期生成文本的渐近行为：连三 token、单层纯注意力模型都可能不收敛；而对含任意深度、LayerNorm、MLP、RoPE 及局部/全局层混合的一大类 transformer，存在 softmax 温度阈值使经验缓存分布收敛到唯一极限，且这类阈值的上确界无穷，故不存在保证全部收敛的全局最小温度。
AI.relevance_reason: 「缓存分布收敛」与温度阈值刻画的是状态演化是否趋于稳定，可能与 latent 推理中循环计算的状态收敛性、缓存结构和停止决策评价相关，但原文面向文本生成的渐近性质，能否迁移到多模态 latent 状态分析可供核查。
